name: Yoru Chocolate
description: A luxe, quiet store theme for a small bean-to-bar chocolatier working at night in a former print shop on Kanzaki-dōri, Hoshikawa City: single-origin bonbons, tablets and gift boxes, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Cocoa-black pages, dark ganache panels, warm cream text and one dusty rose-clay accent; Fanwood Text for display, Gantari for text. The header (H3) carries a serif wordmark and a quiet menu; the home page (L11) opens on bonbons laid on a dark stone slab and moves through the idea, a shelf of four bonbons, a grid of twelve, how a bonbon is made, the warm-weather shipping note and the journal. The footer (F1) holds the wordmark, the origins table and the shop card. Origins (the chocolatier and roaster, the four beans, the shop) and Gift boxes (the box of twelve, keeping and the shipping season), journal, newsletter and contact. The shop details, the warm-weather shipping note and the origins table each live in one synced pattern; each piece's details are product attributes (origin, cacao, pieces or weight, keeps), and cacao and origin print under every price (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop shows a static shelf and orders go by email).

summary.zh-TW: 為小型 bean-to-bar 巧克力工坊打造的沉靜商店主題：夾心巧克力、產地表與夏季寄送說明。
summary.en: A quiet, dark store for a small bean-to-bar chocolatier, with bonbons, an origins table and a warm-weather shipping note.
summary.ja: 小さなビーントゥバーのショコラティエのための静かなストア。ボンボン、産地表、夏季の発送案内付き。
summary.fr: Une boutique calme et sombre pour un petit chocolatier bean-to-bar, avec bonbons, table des origines et note d'expédition estivale.
summary.de: Ein ruhiger, dunkler Shop für einen kleinen Bean-to-Bar-Chocolatier, mit Pralinen, Herkunftstabelle und Sommerversandhinweis.

deviation: Codes: H3 + F1 + L11 as assigned. Palette cocoa #201816, ganache #2E2421, cream #EDE4DA and rose clay #A36A5A; rose clay is kept to rules, numerals and small accents, cream carries body text and buttons. Fonts: Fanwood Text (Regular, Italic) and Gantari (variable) are OFL-1.1, shipped as unmodified TTF in assets/fonts. Page tag gift-boxes is new (Origins uses the about tag); industry chocolatier is new. Images AI-generated with Grok Build and checked by eye for text, marks and logos.

fonts.role: display: headings, the wordmark, prices and italic accents
text: body, labels, the menu, buttons, forms and the origins table

store.withoutPlugin: The Shop page shows a static shelf of the eight pieces with photographs, prices, cacao and origin, and a note to order by email; the home shelf shows four of them; store templates are not used.
